title: cop.evidence-relation/v1
description: Typed epistemic relationship between a TraceRef and an Assertion (Issue #61, #63). Supports non-destructive coexistence of contradictory evidence.

relation_id.description: Unique identifier for this evidence relationship (e.g. evr:<uuid>).

relation_type.description: Qualitative epistemic linkage connecting the trace to the proposition.

strength.description: Optional relation-specific strength or weighting (e.g. conclusive, strong, plausible, weak, or numerical weight 0.0-1.0).

justification.description: Explanatory rationale establishing why the trace supports, contradicts, or contextualizes the assertion.

asserted_by.description: Identity of the agent, evaluator, or rule attributing this relation.

recorded_at.description: When this evidence relation was established and recorded.
